title: Who can message whom
intro: We will see who can message you right away and who needs your permission first.

steps.say: This chat is made up, and nothing is sent. We start with who you trust.
act: We want people to message each other, stay in touch, and see each other's information. We think you should trust your closest friends.
If they are good people, it makes sense to trust their judgment one step removed. Beyond that, we are not sure, so it needs permission.
A close trusted friend|goes straight through
A close friend of a close friend|goes straight through
A friend of a friend, two steps out|needs permission

steps.say: Someone two steps out has to ask first.
act: They get a short request with your reason, and they can say no.
